name: hub
title: Hub
description: Your messages and mail in one place.

tools.name: email_accounts
tools.description: List the user's mailboxes with their account ids and addresses. Use the id with the other email tools when more than one mailbox is set up.

tools.name: email_search_all
tools.description: Search every mailbox's inbox at once with 1 to 4 precise queries, deduplicate the matches, and return at most 12 account-labelled envelopes. Grouped OR works, such as 'since 5-Aug-2026 subject (assessment OR interview)'. Use email_read only for likely matches. This is read-only and replaces listing accounts and searching each mailbox.

limitPerQuery.description: 1 to 10 matches per query and account. Defaults to 5.

maxResults.description: 1 to 12 results in all. Defaults to 12.

tools.name: email_list
tools.description: List message envelopes in a mailbox folder, newest first. Ids are relative to the folder, so pass the same folder to email_read.

account.description: Account id from email_accounts; needed when more than one mailbox is set up.

query.description: A search, such as 'from alice@example.com since 1-Aug-2026' or 'flag unread'.

tools.name: email_folders
tools.description: List a mailbox's folders with their full names and roles. Names differ by provider, so read them here rather than guessing, and pass the exact name to email_list.

account.description: Account id from email_accounts; needed when more than one mailbox is set up.

tools.name: email_read
tools.description: Read one message in full, including headers and text. The id is relative to the folder it was listed from.

id.description: Message id, relative to the folder it was listed from.

account.description: Account id from email_accounts; needed when more than one mailbox is set up.

tools.name: email_attachments
tools.description: Save a message's attachments and return the paths they were written to. email_read names them without downloading, so call this only when you need the files themselves.

id.description: Message id, relative to the folder it was listed from.

account.description: Account id from email_accounts; needed when more than one mailbox is set up.

tools.name: email_send
tools.description: Send an email from one of the user's mailboxes. This delivers immediately, so show the user the exact From, To, Cc, Subject and body and get their approval first. Pass draft: true to save it to Drafts instead: nothing leaves the mailbox, so a draft needs no approval.

account.description: Account id from email_accounts; needed when more than one mailbox is set up.

draft.description: Save to Drafts instead of sending.

attachments.description: Absolute paths of files to attach.
